statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities
The need exists to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197

statements.basis: denial_letter states 'required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained'

statements.statement: The denial was based on missing precertification or prior authorization
